label: Total refraining: at some accessible world where the source exists it gives nothing
definition: WithholdsAllAt F w g: at one accessible world v where g exists, g gives being to nothing. Not the same as there being no contingent concrete being at v: brute or otherwise-caused beings are not excluded.
note: Stipulative giving-level reading of 'could have refrained from creating' (total noncreation scope of optimal-creation-choice.md §56). See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §61. This is TOTAL_REFRAINING_1; world-level total noncreation (NoContingentConcreteIn) is TOTAL_REFRAINING_2. Compare DISAMB-BOUNDED-OMISSION.
